action_description: a very fast 3-hit dual-dagger combo, she stands UPRIGHT the whole time (no crouching, no kneeling), facing right in profile: (1) almost no wind-up, the front dagger snaps out in a short horizontal cut at chest height, the arm fully straight for one clear frame; (2) at once her shoulders turn the other way and the back dagger cuts horizontally across at chest height, arm fully straight for one clear frame; (3) she takes one quick step forward and throws BOTH arms out wide in a strong horizontal double cut in front of her, both daggers fully extended, held for two frames, then she pulls back to her ready stance. Snappy and light, each cut has a clear held hit frame. All cuts are horizontal and stay in FRONT of her body, never across her own body. The white ponytail and black cape flick behind her. Side view facing right in every frame, do not turn toward the camera, same size. Feet on the ground, no jump, no spin, no smoke, no dust.
